messages:
olivia: quick heads-up — small-batch canary (q4v3, long-doc microslice) showed -2.7% MRR vs baseline in the A slice. latency P99 220ms (within 250ms SLO). not an obvious tokenization mismatch. thoughts on fallback threshold / debounce?

devon: ouch. was that across 10k requests or smaller?

olivia: ~3.2k requests in that slice, sample diversity looks ok. here's the eval snippet:
```
slice: long-docs
baseline MRR: 0.345
candidate MRR: 0.336
delta: -0.009 (-2.61%)
samples: 3247
```

kevin: noisy but non-trivial. what's the current auto-fallback threshold? I thought we were at -1.5% for small slices

maria: correct — auto-fallback triggers at delta <= -1.5% AND p<0.05; debounce 10m and hysteresis 2%. For tiny slices we require n>=500.

devon: p-value here?

olivia: p=0.038, effect size ~small. CI doesn't cross zero.

sam: two things: 1) this slice historically shows higher variance; 2) we've had oscillation when fallback threshold too tight -> repeated rollbacks. We should consider a slice-aware confidence bound: widen threshold for high-variance slices or increase debounce window.

kevin: propose: for microslices with var>V0, set threshold to -3% and debounce to 30m; otherwise keep -1.5% & 10m. Also add a bridge state: 'quarantine' where candidate is 75% traffic for 1h before final promote.

maria: we have capacity to run a quick A/B (50/50) for 1h on larger slice to get more power. but that delays rollout.

olivia: @canary-bot please start a 50/50 follow-up run tagged cb-debounce-1 across mixed slices so we can get more power

canary-bot: started experiment cb-debounce-1; routing: 50/50; target slices: long-docs + summary-requests; expected sample ~12k over 1h. watching metrics: MRR, BLEU-ish fidelity, latency.

devon: if A/B still shows delta ~ -2.5% with p<0.05 we should auto-fallback. But add hysteresis so we don't immediately re-promote same variant. Suggest holdout lock for 24h after fallback.

sam: agreed. log a follow-up action item to update rollout policy: adapt threshold by slice variance, add 30m debounce for microslices, add 24h lock after fallback. @maria can you update the policy doc and the console feature flags? :memo:

maria: on it. will update rollout config in prod and open PR. PR will include new param `slice_variance_multiplier` and a `post_fallback_lock_hours: 24` flag.

olivia: thanks all. we'll monitor cb-debounce-1 and reconvene in #eng-ml in 75m. :eyes:
